/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-01.speechText: democratized. Definition: Made available to a wider range of people. In this passage, film democratized access to great performances.
interspersed. Definition: Placed at intervals among other things. In this passage, written explanations are interspersed among silent scenes.

/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-02.speechText: temperance. Definition: Moderation or self-restraint. In this passage, temperance keeps powerful acting from becoming excessive.
discretion. Definition: Good judgment about how to act. In this passage, actors should use discretion to guide their performance.
censure. Definition: Strong criticism or disapproval. In this passage, a thoughtful viewer’s censure outweighs a crowd’s laughter.

/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-03.speechText: ambient. Definition: Present in the surrounding environment. In this passage, ambient sound comes from the scene being filmed.
folklorists. Definition: People who study shared traditions and cultural expressions. In this passage, folklorists study how a video challenge becomes a tradition.
antecedents. Definition: Earlier things that came before something similar. In this passage, frozen theatrical poses are antecedents of the video challenge.

/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-04.speechText: circuit. Definition: A connected system through which a broadcast is sent. In this passage, the circuit brings the play to her walls.
script. Definition: The written words and directions for a play or performance. In this passage, Mildred reads her lines from the script.
exotic. Definition: Unusual and striking because it seems unfamiliar. In this passage, Mildred imagines rooms belonging to exotic people.

/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-05.speechText: promotional. Definition: Intended to attract attention to something and encourage people to buy or support it. In this passage, promotional videos help musicians sell recordings.
abstract. Definition: Using shapes or images rather than showing a recognizable story or scene. In this passage, abstract films do not need to tell a story.
compositing. Definition: Combining images from different sources into one image. In this passage, compositing helps create visual effects.

/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-06.speechText: sanguine. Definition: Having a reddish or flushed complexion. In this passage, his face is naturally sanguine.
meagreness. Definition: Thinness or lack of flesh. In this passage, his overalls emphasize the meagreness of his body.
commanded. Definition: Had a view of or overlooked. In this passage, the telescreen commanded a view of Winston.

/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-07.speechText: reputation. Definition: What other people generally think about a person. In this passage, shared videos can affect someone’s reputation.
expires. Definition: Reaches the end of the time it is available. In this passage, a post may be copied before it expires.
broadcast. Definition: Make information widely known. In this passage, a photo can broadcast where you were.

/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-08.speechText: dwelling. Definition: Continuing to think about something for a long time. In this passage, dwelling on the past can distract us from the present.
sensations. Definition: Feelings noticed through the body or senses. In this passage, noticing bodily sensations can help focus attention.
integrate. Definition: Combine something with an existing activity or whole. In this passage, we can integrate mindfulness into ordinary activities.

/audio/viewtube/kokoro-heart/viewtube-01.speechText: vaudeville. Definition: Stage entertainment made up of several short acts, such as songs, comedy, and tricks. In this passage, vaudeville is one kind of entertainment that makes room for movies.
